data.name: Deadtime Defenders 2
data.detailed_description:
Deadtime Defenders 2 is an online, co-op (or single player), 2D side-scrolling, looter shooter. Unstable portals are unleashing chaos from alternate dimensions… and you're humanity's last line of defense. Collect legendary loot, complete high-risk missions and bounties, and create the perfect Defender in this online, co-op, side-scrollin', lootin’-shootin' RPG!

Improved Fidelity

  • Deadtime Defenders has been fully rebuilt with a focus on multiplayer and elevated quality across every aspect of the original.

  • All-new 2.5D visuals that blend depth and style for a sharper, more dynamic look.

  • Powered by FMOD for a more immersive, responsive audio experience.

Online Multiplayer

  • Squad up with up to two friends—or go solo—and take down mini-bosses and their minions, complete missions, and collect legendary loot.

Shoot and Loot

  • Endless randomized loot—each drop rolls unique stats and abilities.

  • All-new mission system—dynamic objectives built for more engaging game play.

  • Daily rotating missions keep the targets fresh—there’s always a new goal to chase.

Build the Ultimate Defender

  • Customize your character to create your ultimate Defender.

  • All new Tech Tree for character perks that enhance your unique play-style. Coordinate your squad loadouts and dominate.

  • Customize your weapons with mods to max out your damage and then apply paint sprays to show off your style.

  • Re-roll items to dial in the perfect stat combinations—built to help you take down tougher enemies.

End-Game

  • Max level isn’t the finish line—it’s where the real game begins. Step into high-stakes endgame missions where the biggest risks deliver the best loot.
